# V1.3 — Feature batch

**Status:** Done, all items committed on `main`. Grilled & locked 2026-06-26 (`/grill-with-docs`), docs commit `84ed23e`.

New ADRs: **0017** (customizable navbar), **0018** (shared accounts & categories), **0019** (transaction-linked partner debt), **0020** (receipts follow transaction visibility). New `CONTEXT.md` glossary terms: shared account, shared category, revert-to-creator, debt netting, paid on behalf, settlement.

Recommended build order was **1 → 5 → 2 → 3(+bug#1) → 7 → 8 → 6 → 13 → 10 → 9 → 12 → 14 → 11** (cheap/independent → architectural). Two grilling catches shrank scope: item 6 (icons) and item 13 (receipts) already had their data columns/path (incl. partner DTOs) in place from V1's `attachmentUrl` scaffold — item 6 needed no schema/Room change at all, item 13 reused the existing `attachment_url`. Item 9 (net) was already computed — only the netting logic itself was new.

## Bug fix

| # | What | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Nav tabs and cards don't update colors when changing themes** | Fixed as part of feature item 3 below. Root cause: `surfaceContainer*` tokens were never set, so `NavigationBar` (`surfaceContainer`) and `Card` (`surfaceContainerHigh`) fell back to M3 neutral grey. Fixed by the ramp helper in `IponPalettes.kt`. |

| 9 | **Debt netting** | `b153e01` | Room v14 (`@AutoMigration(13→14)`). `isNetting: Boolean` + `counterDebtId: String?` on `DebtPaymentEntity`/`DebtPayment`/DTO. `DebtNettingCalculator` (pure FIFO: opposing debts oldest-first, `DeterministicUuid.v5("netting:$debtId:$counterDebtId")` for convergent offline IDs). `ApplyDebtNettingUseCase` reads active debts+payments, calls calculator, upserts payment pairs; invoked from `UpsertPartnerDebtUseCase`. `deleteDebt` cascades soft-delete to all netting payments on both sides. `DeterministicUuid` relocated `feature/recurring` → `core/util/`. 386 tests pass (+17). |
| 10 | **Fully customizable navbar** | `0370b3f` | No Room/schema/sync changes. `NavRegistry`+`NavDestination` replace the old `TopLevelDestination` enum. `NavConfig` (pure pin/unpin/move with invariants). `NavResolver` (pure paired-aware resolution). `NavConfigRepository` (DataStore, local only). `NavbarEditorScreen`: drag-to-reorder (long-press handle) + pin/unpin, live bar preview. `IponApp` rewritten: dynamic bar (≤4 pins + More), `MoreSheet` (4-col grid + Edit navbar); all registry destinations stay in the NavHost so `saveState`/`restoreState` work across dynamic pin sets. `ThemeDraftRepository` singleton lets `PersonalizeViewModel` live-preview the entire `IponTheme` incl. navbar. Also fixed a pre-existing crash: `materializeRecurringRules()` in `MainActivity.onStart` is now auth-gated. 18 new tests (369 total). |
| 11 | **Shared accounts + categories** | `b96ca0b` | **Opus.** Room v17 (`@AutoMigration(16→17)`). Emulator-verified. Schema: `accounts`/`categories` gain `couple_id`+`created_by`, `user_id` nullable + owner-check constraints (mirrors budgets); `accounts_couple`/`categories_couple` RLS; `partner_accounts`/`partner_categories` views hardened (`couple_id is null`); `enforce_no_private_on_shared_account()` BEFORE-trigger on `transactions` (a CHECK can't span tables); `unpair()` reverts shared accts/cats to creator. Entity/DTO/mapper: `coupleId`+`createdBy` (+nullable `userId`); domain gains `isShared`. DAO: `observeAccounts`/`observeCategories` now `(userId=:me OR coupleId IS NOT NULL)`; `revertOwnCoupleRowsToCreator`+`deleteCoupleRowsNotCreatedBy`. Repo: `shareAccount`/`unshareAccount` (+category twins) = revert-to-creator, ring bell. Balance: new `observeForBalances(userId)` → `observeBalanceLedger()` so shared accounts sum both partners. `TransactionValidator` gains `PRIVATE_ON_SHARED_ACCOUNT`; UI force-clears private + hides the toggle on shared accounts. `SharedBadge` + share/unshare menu on cards (paired only). 15 new tests (416 total). **Live migration applied 2026-06-27** (`supabase/migrations/2026-06-27_shared_accounts_categories.sql`, `1c1858b`) — verified post-apply. |
| 12 | **"Paid on behalf" auto-debt** | `ded56d7` | Room v15 (`@AutoMigration(14→15)`). Nullable `sourceTransactionId` on `PartnerDebtEntity`/`PartnerDebt`/DTO, set once at creation, survives edits. `schema.sql`: `source_transaction_id uuid` on `partner_debts` (no FK — fire-and-forget). New `PaidOnBehalfUseCase` (wraps `UpsertTransactionUseCase` + `UpsertPartnerDebtUseCase`, which triggers item 9's netting): records the txn, then a debt (borrower=partner, lender=me, amount=owed); validates `0 < owed ≤ txn.amount`. `TransactionsScreen`: "Paid for {partner}" switch + "Amount owed (₱)" field, shown only when paired + create-only + EXPENSE. 6 new tests (392 total). |
| 13 | **Receipt attachments on transactions** | `502bfaf` | Room v13 (`@AutoMigration(12→13)`). `attachmentLocalPath: String?` on `TransactionEntity`/domain (local-only, not in DTO). `TransactionDao.pendingReceiptUploads()`/`markReceiptUploaded()`. `ReceiptUploader` (`PreSyncStep`): compress (max 1080px, JPEG 85%) → upload to `receipts/{userId}/{txnId}.jpg` → stamp `attachmentUrl` → clear `localPath`. Gallery picker, 56dp thumbnail with remove X, full-screen dialog. `schema.sql`: `attachment_url` added to `partner_transactions` view (nulled on private/deleted); `receipts_owner`+`receipts_partner_read` storage policies. 351 tests pass. **Pre-ship: create `receipts` bucket (public=false); apply storage policies + view DDL** — resolved, see [infra state](project-build-progress.md#infra-state). |
| 14 | **Transaction-linked settlements** | `87ee6c4` | Room v16 (`@AutoMigration(15→16)`). `is_settlement` flag on `TransactionEntity`/domain/DTO/partner DTO; `payorAccountId`/`payorTxnId`/`receiverTxnId` (nullable) on `DebtPaymentEntity`/domain/DTO. **Payor leg** `SettleDebtUseCase`: own flagged EXPENSE (no category) + couple-owned `DebtPayment` linking `payorAccountId`+`payorTxnId`. **Receiver leg** `AddSettlementIncomeUseCase`: own flagged INCOME + `stampReceiverTxn(paymentId, txnId)` (first-writer-wins). Settlement links preserved once-set. `TransactionValidator` waives `CATEGORY_REQUIRED` for settlement legs. Analysis (`AnalysisCalculator`/`ExpenseFlowCalculator`/`DailyNetCalculator`) excludes settlements; `AccountBalanceCalculator` still counts them (money moved). UI: `PartnerDebtScreen` reworked to a single sealed `DebtDialog` (AddDebt/Settle/Receive) + account picker. 9 new tests (401 total). **Pre-ship: apply `is_settlement` column, the 3 `partner_debt_payments` columns, updated `partner_transactions` view DDL** — resolved, see [infra state](project-build-progress.md#infra-state). |
